sources.title: FY2027 Congressional Justification, Policy Development and Research
Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) FY2027 Budget Request: In Brief (CRS R48927)

status_summary: No suspension of PD&R external research and evaluation grants, and no realignment of non-data functions out of the office, was found. HUD's FY2027 budget request, released 2026-04-03, would cut PD&R research and technology funding to $63.0 million from $122.5 million enacted for FY2026, mainly by reducing survey sample sizes, while continuing research partnerships with a 50 percent partner match and launching new evaluations aligned with administration priorities. That request is a parallel budget proposal, not enacted, and it trims the survey work the Mandate would keep.

timeline.event: The Administration submitted its FY2027 budget request to Congress on 2026-04-03 (per CRS). HUD's congressional justification proposes PD&R research and technology funding of $63.0 million, down from $122.5 million enacted for FY2026; the CRS table for the same account shows about $43 million.

title: Suspend PD&R external research grants and narrow the office to data and surveys
uncertainties: The HUD rule list on reginfo.gov (labeled Agency Rule List - 2026, 54 rules) lists no rulemaking on PD&R research or evaluation grants; RIN 2529-AB11 rescinds a fair housing data collection requirement and is not the recommended action. HUD's Evaluation Policy notice (2026-09-24) states that most research and evaluation is done through competitively awarded external grants and contracts. The FY2027 PD&R justification carries no printed date, and the hud.gov PD&R page could not be fetched. The justification (re-opened in this review) gives $63.0 million for the Research and Technology account, 59.5 million dollars below the FY2026 enacted level, while CRS report R48927 shows the account falling by about 80 million dollars (65 percent) to about $43 million; the difference was not reconciled. One early 2025 union estimate of staffing reductions is not counted. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
